# goslop text fixture — logger.exception then bare re-raise surfaces the
# failure (Project_Parva middleware FP shape). No DB rollback.
lang: python
file: middleware.py
---
import logging
logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

async def request_context(request, call_next):
    try:
        response = await call_next(request)
    except Exception as exc:
        logger.exception("request.error: %s", type(exc).__name__)
        raise
    return response
